route.rationale: Two control-plane defects found live in this session, one theme: a command must reach the store its calling session belongs to. (1) bee route (set/show) hardcodes resolve_mutation_target(root, None, ..., false) at workflows.rs:704,744,747 where gate passes lane_feature/no_lane (set_gate.rs:691,707), so a lane-bound session records its route onto state.json and silently overwrites a sibling lane's triage. public-contracts: route grows the same lane/no-lane flag pair gate documents. (2) worktree new/register bootstraps onboarding.json and config.json into the new worktree store (registry.rs:838) but never the .bee/bin/bee binary, so every bee command inside a fresh worktree dies. covered-contract-change: existing state_group and worktree tests assert the current target-resolution and bootstrap report shapes.
